stories.title: Ravita's love story behind husband's murder:Showed injuries to boyfriend on video calls; Meerut court sentences both to death
stories.summary: In Meerut, a court has sentenced Ravita, who had her husband Amit murdered and then had a snake bite him, and her lover Amardeep to death. Ravita, a mother of three, met Amardeep six months before Amit's murder. Amit had invited his friend Amardeep home for a meal. When Ravita served Amardeep dal and rice, he fell in love with her. One day, he came to her and confessed his feelings. A few days later, he handed Ravita a slip of paper with his mobile number written on it. Ravita video-called Amardeep and showed him the injuries from beatings on her body. She said, "My husband is cruel. He beats me a lot." As the two grew closer, they decided to live together. However, they began planning Amit's murder to make it appear that no one could suspect them. That is why they planned to have him bitten by a snake. Where did Amardeep and Ravita meet for the first time? How was their affair exposed in front of Amit? When did they plan the murder? To find out, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to police officers involved in the case. Read the report... They first met over a meal, and the lover gave her his mobile number on a slip In police custody, Amardeep and Ravita told their respective stories. Interrogation in separate rooms after their arrest revealed that their love story was only six months old. The question was what had happened that led them to plan Amit's murder in such a short time. Amardeep said, "I met Amit at a site about a year ago. We became friends because we worked together. This was in October 2024. I told him that it was difficult to find good food in the market, so one day he took me to his home for a meal. That was when I first met Ravita." I returned after eating lentils and rice, but I could not forget Ravita. Then one day, when I went to Amit's house to pick him up, I met Ravita again. That day, I told Ravita how I felt. She did not say anything, but looking into her eyes, I felt that she was ready too. I was afraid, so I did not try again. A month passed in this way. Then one day, we met at the market. That day, I wrote my mobile number on a slip of paper and gave it to her. Ravita then called me, and we began talking. Ravita told me, "Amit beats me; he is heartless. He has sex with me as if I were not his wife." Hearing all this, I became emotional. She also showed me the injuries on her body over a video call. Gradually, we decided that we would get married. I also started going to her house when Amit was away. Boyfriend said: Amit beat me on 23 March and threatened to kill me In the meantime, Amit found out about our affair. In fact, he had seen us together. After that, he said a lot to Ravita. I met Amit on 23 March 2025. He assaulted me then. I needed 15 stitches in my hand. After that, Amit sent four or five boys after me. They would appear along the way, and one or two of them also came to my house to summon me. But I did not go with them. After that, whenever Amit met me, he threatened me, saying, "I will kill you." He would say, "I will kill Ravita; I will cut her up." Meanwhile, Ravita told me that Amit was harassing her. They were quarrelling every day. I first told Ravita, "You should divorce him; after that, we will get married." But Amit was not ready for this. He insisted, "No matter what happens, I will not divorce you." Ravita searched: How to evade the police after committing murder Ravita said, "I cannot leave Amit like this. He has a family too; he must be removed from the way." After this, Ravita began searching on her mobile phone for ways to commit murder. The police found the following searches in her Google search history: "How to evade the police after committing murder?" and "Easy ways to commit murder." Meanwhile, one day, a neighbour again told Amit about Ravita's affair. That day, Amit beat Ravita. On 5 April 2025, Ravita called and said, "Arrange a snake. Amit now has to be eliminated." For the next seven days, the two of them kept thinking about how to kill Amit. What happened on the night of the murder, 12 April... A snake was arranged through Nikhil So that people would not become suspicious, Ravita took Amit to Saharanpur in the morning to visit the Mata Shakambhari Devi temple. From there, she continued posting videos of herself on Instagram. Meanwhile, Amardeep was arranging the snake. He told the police that he first spoke to a boy named Rajkumar, who lived in Bahsuma. Rajkumar gave him Nikhil's number. Nikhil arranged the deal with the snake charmer. The snake charmer took ₹1,000, placed the snake in a sack and handed it over to him. He then brought the snake home. Ravita quarrelled with Amit and went to sleep in the adjoining room Meanwhile, as planned, Ravita quarrelled with Amit after returning from Saharanpur. She took the children and went to sleep in the adjoining room. Ravita called me and said, "He has beaten me again. He will kill me. We have to finish the matter today. Bring the snake." I then went to her house, which was about 600 metres away. There was complete silence in the house. The two of us went into Amit's room. Amit was fast asleep. We tried to take the snake out of the sack, but became afraid that it might bite one of us. We suddenly did not know what to do. Then we decided to hold Amit's hands and legs and strangle him. Ravita held his hands while I strangled Amardeep. He kept flailing his arms and legs, but his body became still within 3 minutes. I then placed the snake beside Amit and left the house. How did the entire case come to light? Read on Children saw a snake on their father's bed On the morning of 13 April, Ravita's son went to his father's room to wake him up. He saw a snake on the bed. The boy began screaming when he saw it. Ravita, who was sleeping in another room, also ran towards Amit's room. Once there, she pretended to cry, scream and shout. A crowd of neighbours gathered at the scene. When they saw a live snake on the bed, they panicked. Everyone thought Amit had died after being bitten by the snake. A snake charmer was called, and he somehow caught the snake. A Forest Department team also reached the scene. The neighbours and relatives became convinced that the snake had bitten Amit throughout the night. There were snake-bite marks at 10 places on his body, but Amit's uncle became suspicious. He said, "We will have a post-mortem conducted before the cremation." The police were called. The post-mortem report revealed that Amit had died from strangulation. The presence of poison in his body was not established. The police then began questioning Ravita. After five hours of questioning, Ravita revealed the truth. After Amardeep's name emerged, he too was arrested. Ravita had said: Amit beats me and says he will make me a prostitute Ravita had told the police, "Amit beats me. After finding out about my affair, he used to threaten me, saying, 'I will make you engage in prostitution.' What could I do? Amit himself had arranged for me to speak to Amardeep." “Amit used to beat me badly. He had said that he would kill me. He wanted to turn me into a prostitute. So I planned to kill him with Amardeep. He brought the snake. I held Amit's hands and covered his mouth, while Amardeep strangled him. After that, we placed the snake under his body. Amardeep then went home.”

stories.summary: Om Prakash Rajbhar: उत्तर प्रदेश की राजनीति में बयानों और सियासी हमलों का दौर लगातार जारी है। इसी बीच समाजवादी पार्टी के प्रवक्ता आशुतोष वर्मा ने मंत्री ओम प्रकाश राजभर के बयान पर तीखी प्रतिक्रिया देते हुए उन पर निशाना साधा है। आशुतोष वर्मा ने राजभर की राजनीतिक स्थिति, उनकी पार्टी के भविष्य और भारतीय जनता पार्टी के साथ उनके संबंधों को लेकर तंज कसा। उन्होंने कहा कि ओपी राजभर की पार्टी में अब उनके बच्चों के अलावा कोई साथ नहीं रह गया है और उनके विधायक भी उनके साथ नहीं हैं। सपा प्रवक्ता ने दावा किया कि राजभर अब अपनी राजनीतिक पारी के अंतिम दौर में हैं और राजभर समाज भी उनसे आगे बढ़ चुका है। उन्होंने तंज भरे लहजे में कहा कि भाजपा में विलय करने से पहले उन्हें अपने बच्चों को सेट कर लेना चाहिए, वरना यह मौका भी हाथ से निकल सकता है। उनके इस बयान ने प्रदेश की सियासत में जुबानी जंग को और तेज कर दिया है।

stories.title: Mayawati fields Akash to boost BSP campaign:To hold rallies in 5 UP seats, Punjab and Uttarakhand
stories.summary: After making his fourth comeback in the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP), Akash Anand is set to step up his political activities once again. Party chief Mayawati has assigned him the responsibility of addressing public meetings in Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Uttarakhand. Seven public meetings are planned for Akash over the next two months. Candidates from several Assembly constituencies have also requested him to address rallies in their areas. His increased activity signals that Akash Anand is likely to play a more active role as the BSP prepares for the 2027 Assembly elections. Akash Anand to hold 7 public meetings across UP, Punjab and Uttarakhand The BSP central office has released the schedule of public meetings by party national coordinator Akash Anand. He will address five meetings in Uttar Pradesh, along with one each in Punjab and Uttarakhand, over the next two months. According to the schedule, meetings will be held in Anupshahr, Bulandshahr, on October 28; Nakur, Saharanpur, on November 2; Bikapur, Ayodhya, on November 20; Agra on November 22; and Bilhaur, Kanpur, on November 29. Meetings are also planned in Punjab on November 26 and Haridwar, Uttarakhand, on December 6. The venue for the Punjab meeting has not yet been finalised. Mayawati again expresses confidence in Akash After taking Akash Anand back into the party, BSP chief Mayawati appointed him national coordinator. He had earlier been expelled from the party. Following his return, Akash was also seen alongside Mayawati at the event marking Kanshi Ram's death anniversary on October 9, where he expressed his respect for her. With a series of public meetings now being planned, Mayawati appears to be preparing to give Akash an important role ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. The programme is being seen as significant amid the ongoing discussions within the party between his supporters and opponents. He has addressed election rallies before Before his latest expulsion from the party, Akash Anand had addressed public meetings in Sadabad in Hathras and in Noida. The Sadabad meeting attracted attention across the country. Following his return to the BSP, preparations are now underway to send him to different regions once again. BSP candidates have also been requesting that Akash address rallies in their constituencies. Through these meetings, the party aims to increase activity among its workers and strengthen public outreach ahead of the 2027 Assembly elections. Eye on other communities alongside the Dalit vote Before the 2027 election, the BSP faces the challenge of retaining its traditional Dalit support base while increasing its support among other social groups. The proposed rallies in Anupshahr, Nakur, Bikapur, Agra and Bilhaur are significant in this regard. Through these programmes, the party may seek to strengthen its presence in different regions. Reaching Saini community voters and other backward classes in western Uttar Pradesh may also be part of the BSP's strategy. Meanwhile, by holding meetings in Punjab and Uttarakhand, the party is trying to activate its organisation in other states as well. 6 December rally also has political significance Akash Anand's last proposed rally will be held in Haridwar on 6 December. The day is observed as Dr B. R. Ambedkar's Mahaparinirvan Diwas. The date is ideologically and organisationally important for the BSP. In this context, Ambedkarite ideology, social justice and strengthening the organisation are likely to be the key issues at the Haridwar rally. Meanwhile, the Azad Samaj Party, led by its president Chandrashekhar Azad, has also proposed an event at the Ramabai Ambedkar Maidan in Lucknow on Constitution Day, 26 November. The programmes organised by the BSP will also be watched amid the growing activity of various parties in Dalit politics. When did Mayawati assign Akash responsibilities and when did she remove him? Find out 10 December 2023- Mayawati called a meeting of leaders from Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand. At the meeting, she declared Akash, the son of her youngest brother Anand Kumar, her successor. On 7 May 2024, Mayawati stripped Akash of all responsibilities over his inappropriate remarks. She removed him as national coordinator as well as from the post of successor. Mayawati said Akash was still immature. Mayawati reversed her decision 47 days later. 23 June 2024 She reinstated him as her successor and assigned him the responsibility of national coordinator, but on 2 March 2025, she again stripped him of all responsibilities. 3 March 2025- Mayawati expelled Akash from the party. She said Akash should have shown his maturity by expressing remorse. Instead, under the influence of his father-in-law, he became selfish and arrogant. 13 April- Mayawati forgave Akash. She had said, "I will not make Akash my successor." Three months later, that is, on 18 May, Mayawati once again appointed Akash chief national coordinator. She said Akash was being given a second chance. 29 August A new post of national convenor was created in the party, and Akash was given responsibility as national convenor. 3 September- Mayawati removed Akash from the post of national convenor. She said he still needed to become more mature. 9 September- Mayawati set a condition for handing responsibilities back to Akash: his father-in-law had to retire from political life. 10 September- Mayawati expelled him from the party. A few hours later, Akash's father-in-law, Ashok Siddharth, announced his retirement from politics. Akash Anand married Pragya, daughter of Ashok Siddharth, on 26 March 2023. Mayawati also attended the wedding. -File photo Now read about Mayawati's recent decisions 6 September: After removing Akash, Mayawati assigned her nephew Ishan the responsibility of reviewing the organisation in 19 states. 13 September: Mayawati announced that not only Akash but Ishan, too, would not be given any position in the party. She indicated that her niece, Deepika Anand, would be promoted within the party. Akash Entered Politics in 2017​​ Akash Anand was seen with Mayawati at a public rally in Saharanpur in 2017. He then continued working for the party. He was appointed national coordinator in 2019. After this, the BSP-SP alliance broke up. At the time, it emerged that Mayawati had ended the alliance at Akash's behest. Akash Anand's name appeared on the list of star campaigners for the first time during the 2022 Himachal Pradesh Assembly election. Akash pursued a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in London.

stories.title: Yogi says SP mortgaged Rajya Sabha tickets to wealthy donors:Claims party could have contested 2–3 seats; mocks PDA as ‘Paraya Dhan Apna’
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath accused the Samajwadi Party (SP) of giving away its Rajya Sabha tickets to wealthy people in exchange for money. Speaking at a public meeting in Ghaziabad on Friday, he claimed that the party could have contested two or three seats but chose to give its tickets to others. Without naming SP chief Akhilesh Yadav, Yogi said, “You have seen how the Samajwadi Party has worked to sell tickets in the Rajya Sabha election. They could have contested two or three seats. But I have been saying from the beginning that the SP's PDA means ‘Parivar Development Authority’.” He added, “They gave their first ticket to their uncle. The BJP had said that PDA means ‘Paraya Dhan Apna’ — making someone else's wealth one's own. In this situation, they mortgaged their second ticket to a wealthy man from Mumbai. This is their true character.” Yogi addresses MLC election meeting in Ghaziabad Yogi was speaking at a public meeting for the MLC graduates' and teachers' constituency elections at Sunderdeep Deemed University in Dasna, Ghaziabad. Dinesh Kumar Goyal and Shrichand Sharma are contesting the election. Goyal is from Ghaziabad, while Sharma is from Gautam Buddh Nagar. Voters from the Meerut and Saharanpur divisions will cast their votes in the election. Before the meeting, the Chief Minister was scheduled to inspect the sewage treatment plant (STP) in Indirapuram. However, the inspection programme was cancelled. Know Yogi's 8 key points 1- 'Durga Puja pandals could not be set up under the SP government' Yogi said that during the Samajwadi Party's rule, Kanwar yatras, Ramleela performances and Durga Puja pandals faced restrictions. He claimed that if the SP were in power today, there would be riots and curfews. He said grand Ramleela performances are now being held at several places during Sharadiya Navratri, with no unrest during Kanwar yatras. 2- ‘Development was a distant prospect under the SP government’ Yogi accused the SP of neglecting development, education and employment. He said that during its four terms in power, the state faced crises related to security, development, identity and jobs. He claimed that riots, curfews, loot, damaged roads and power shortages had become the state's identity under the SP government. 3- ‘SP followed different rules for education’ Yogi alleged that the SP government followed different standards for educational institutions. Referring to Azam Khan's university, he claimed that it received different treatment, while other institutions seeking recognition faced difficulties. He said the BJP government had introduced the same rules for everyone and followed the principle of “Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas”. 4- ‘Religious sites are being developed under the BJP government’ Yogi said grand corridors had been built at the Kashi Vishwanath and Maa Vindhyavasini temples, while a grand Ram temple had been built in Ayodhya. He also referred to development in Mathura-Vrindavan and the ongoing corridor project at the Maa Shakumbhari Devi temple in Saharanpur. He said an elevated road near the temple would be completed after this year to make visits easier for devotees. 5- ‘Most districts in UP now have a medical college’ Yogi said universities had been established in Aligarh, Moradabad, Azamgarh, Balrampur, Mirzapur and Saharanpur. He also cited the sports university in Meerut, the Ayush university in Gorakhpur, the agricultural university in Kushinagar and a university for persons with disabilities in Bundelkhand. He claimed that most districts in Uttar Pradesh now had a medical college. 6- ‘Those who play with youth employment will go to jail’ Yogi said Uttar Pradesh was now known for “One District, One Product” rather than “One District, One Mafia”. He said travel between Meerut and Prayagraj now takes around six hours and pointed to metro services in Meerut, Ghaziabad, Noida, Kanpur and Lucknow as signs of development. He added that the BJP government had provided government jobs to 9.5 lakh people in nine years. He warned that anyone who interfered with young people's employment would face jail and action against their property. 7- ‘SP cannot be trusted on education’ Yogi accused the SP of playing with the future of young people and opposing education. Comparing the party to a crocodile that promises to help people cross a river but instead drowns them, he said the SP could not be trusted to fulfil its promises on education. 8- ‘Yogi appeals to voters to elect BJP candidates’ Yogi appealed to teachers and graduate voters in the Meerut division to ensure the victory of BJP candidates in both the teachers' and graduates' constituency elections. He said voters in the division had supported the party earlier and expressed confidence that they would do so again. The Election Commission has declared October 23 a holiday in connection with the elections.

stories.title: Accused opens fire at police during Rajkot robbery-murder panchnama:PSI shoots him in leg in retaliation; former employee plotted crime after being fired
stories.summary: In the sensational robbery-cum-murder case at Tanvi Gold Refinery in Rajkot, the main shooter, Anurag Singh Rajput, who allegedly opened fire during the robbery, attacked the police team when he was taken to the scene to prepare a panchnama and collect evidence. Anurag suddenly fired two rounds at police personnel using another concealed weapon that he had hidden at the spot, triggering panic and chaos. Following the sudden attack on the police team, Crime Branch PSI Vanrajsinh Dodiya showed presence of mind and exceptional courage, immediately returning fire in self-defence. The bullet fired by the PSI struck Anurag in the leg, causing him to collapse to the ground in a pool of blood. The police immediately took him into custody. Anurag, who sustained serious injuries after being shot in the leg, was rushed to Rajkot Civil Hospital for treatment under tight police security. Following the attack on the police, senior police officers also rushed to the scene and the hospital. Property worth more than ₹1.52 crore recovered The police have solved the case involving the murder of Laljibhai Sardhara and the robbery of 1 kg of gold and 3 kg of silver outside Tanvi Gold Refinery in Rajkot's Aji GIDC area on 14 October, when he was shot at three times. Teams from Rajkot City Police carried out the operation in coordination with police from three to four districts and two states. They arrested all 10 accused belonging to a notorious Uttar Pradesh gang within just 9 hours. The police successfully recovered 100% of the stolen property, including the gold and silver, worth more than ₹1.52 crore in total. Gold hidden in shoes and car seat covers Joint Police Commissioner Chaitanya Mandlik said that after carrying out the robbery, the accused had cleverly concealed the gold and silver bars inside their shoes and car seat covers to evade the police investigation. However, with the help of AI technology, the CCTV network and human intelligence, the police traced the links between the accused and arrested all 10 of them along with the stolen property. The Home Minister has also praised the Rajkot Police for this swift success. Former employee emerged as mastermind, current staff member provided a tip-off The police investigation has revealed that the robbery was not a sudden incident but a planned conspiracy. Ashwinikumar, aka Lankesh Singh, who had previously worked at Tanvi Gold Refinery for 5-6 months, was the alleged mastermind behind the crime. Meanwhile, Shaileshkumar Kherwa aka Shailendra Singh, who currently works at the refinery, provided all the inside information. Shailesh kept Lankesh informed about every development, including exactly when the manager would leave with the refined gold and silver. Lankesh had given clear instructions to his associates to shoot anyone who came in their way during the robbery. Fired three rounds and sped away in the car at 120 km/h On 14 October, when the manager was travelling to the showroom on an Activa carrying gold bars and silver dust powder from the refinery, people in a maroon Tata Tigor tried to snatch the bag. When Laljibhai Sardhara and the security guard resisted, accused Anurag Singh Rajput fired three precise rounds at Laljibhai, causing serious injuries that proved fatal. After the robbery, the accused sped towards Chotila at 120 km/h, where they changed vehicles and fled towards Rajasthan and Morbi in a Kia Sonet and an Eicher. Arrests made in a joint operation across Rajasthan, Morbi and Rajkot By imposing roadblocks and tracing vehicle routes, the police obtained assistance from the Rajasthan Police. A total of 10 accused have been arrested – six from Pindwara and Udaipur in Rajasthan, three from Morbi and one from Rajkot. All the accused are residents of Chandauli, Ghazipur and Mau districts in Uttar Pradesh. Among those arrested, cases of attempted murder had previously been registered in Uttar Pradesh against Ashwini, aka Lankesh, and Ajit Kumar Pandey, a case of culpable homicide against Anurag Singh, and criminal cases in Haryana against Shailesh Kherwa. 'E-beat system' to be implemented in Rajkot for security To enhance the security of traders and citizens during the festive season, the police department has prepared a special action plan. The city will be divided into different beats and round-the-clock patrolling will be launched. In addition, a digital 'e-beat system' will be implemented in the coming days, ensuring online tracking of all police patrolling and checking activities.

stories.title: Girl who abused Chandrashekhar says, 'We are staunch Brahmins':Claims rapes happened under Akhilesh’s government, arrested by Gonda police
stories.summary: Pallavi Shukla, a woman from Gonda who had abused Chandrashekhar Azad, has made objectionable remarks against Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav. The social media creator posted a video on Facebook in which she said, “We are staunch Brahmins. No matter what happens, we will never support Yadavs.” Pallavi said that the bicycle, the SP's election symbol, would always remain rusty, while the lotus would continue to bloom. She also said that anyone could file as many cases against her as they wanted. Following a complaint by Gonda SP leader Waqar Khan, Kaudiya police arrested Pallavi from her home at around 4:15 pm. Posted a 1-minute, 46-second video In the video, Pallavi said that the person who had created a video of Akhilesh Yadav using AI should delete it. She then abused the Yadav community and said that she did not support Yadavs because she belonged to the Brahmin community. She also said that her father was a staunch Hindu. Pallavi said that people could be angry or happy with her, but she would continue to speak the truth. She claimed that girls were raped and were not safe under the SP government. She added that the lotus would continue to bloom. Making further objectionable remarks against Akhilesh Yadav, she said that the bicycle had become rusty when the SP came to power. She also made comments about people who eat meat and chicken, saying they try to present themselves as a brand. She further said that the bicycle could not be trusted because it could get punctured anywhere on the road. Throughout the video, Pallavi abused Akhilesh Yadav four times and used abusive language against the Yadav community an equal number of times. She also made offensive comments about the Muslim community. Lives in a village in Gonda, has over 42,000 Facebook followers Pallavi Shukla is a resident of Baunapur village under the Kaudiya police station area in Gonda. She has more than 42,000 followers on Facebook. Her father, Panchanan Shukla, is a farmer, and she has studied up to Class 12. Her brother went missing seven years ago and has not been found yet. Pallavi makes reels on Bhojpuri songs and posts them on Facebook. According to the report, her family has distanced itself from her. Case registered earlier for abusing Chandrashekhar After the video went viral, SP leader Waqar Khan, the party's in-charge for the Katra Bazar Assembly constituency, filed a complaint at the Kaudiya police station. Station House Officer Shashi Kumar Rana said police took note of the viral video, registered a case against Pallavi Shukla and arrested her. Earlier, Pallavi had also abused Nagina MP Chandrashekhar Azad and members of the Scheduled Caste community. On July 3 this year, a case was registered against her at the Kaudiya police station based on a complaint by sub-inspector Sheshmani Pandey. She was accused of abusing Chandrashekhar and threatening to beat him with shoes and slippers.

stories.title: 2 die after oxygen cylinder-loaded pickup hits divider:Both were trapped in the cabin after the collision in Lucknow; third person critical
stories.summary: Two people died and a third person is in critical condition after an oxygen cylinder-loaded pickup truck collided with a divider in Lucknow on Friday evening. The accident took place near the Sheikhpura toll plaza in the Nigohan area. The impact badly damaged the front of the pickup, trapping two people inside the cabin. The collision was so powerful that the oxygen cylinders loaded in the vehicle scattered across the road. Nigohan police reached the spot after receiving information about the accident. With the help of local residents, they rescued the trapped people and rushed the injured to the Mohanlalganj Community Health Centre (CHC). The identities of the injured people have not yet been established. Police got the cylinders scattered across the road removed and restored normal traffic. See 2 pictures... Two people trapped inside the cabin At around 4:30 p.m. on Friday, Nigohan police received information that a pickup loaded with oxygen cylinders had collided with a divider near the Sheikhpura toll plaza. As soon as the information was received, the Nigohan station house officer reached the spot with a police team. The front of the pickup had been crushed in the collision, trapping two people, including the driver, inside the cabin. Efforts under way to identify the injured With the help of local residents, the police pulled both people out and sent them to the Mohanlalganj Community Health Centre for treatment. The oxygen cylinders loaded in the pickup had scattered across the road during the accident. The police and local residents collected the cylinders and had them placed in a safe location. The obstruction was then cleared from the road and traffic was restored to normal. Efforts are under way to identify the injured.

stories.title: Akhilesh says he opposes BJP's conspiracy, not SIR or SSR:Submits data on voter list irregularities in 100 seats to EC
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav once again accused the BJP of conspiring to manipulate the voter list. He said his party was not opposed to SIR or SSR, but to the alleged conspiracy and irregularities involved in the process. He demanded that the voter list should be revised only once. There should be no repeated revisions. The process of adding or deleting names should be completed during that revision. The former chief minister held a press conference at the party office on Friday. During the event, former BJP MP Rajpal and state executive member Harbir Malik joined the party. Akhilesh Yadav claimed that the BJP's core voters were moving away from it. Sanatanis, women, the middle class and young people were also angry with the party. This was why a conspiracy was now being carried out in collusion with the Election Commission to manipulate the voter list, he said. He said the Samajwadi Party had submitted data from 100 Assembly constituencies to the Election Commission, showing irregularities carried out or orchestrated by the BJP. Key points from Akhilesh Yadav's press conference... 1- Claim that one young man is registered to vote in several places Giving an example of alleged irregularities in the voter lists, Akhilesh Yadav said his party had submitted data from 100 assembly constituencies to the Election Commission. He referred to a young man who is set to vote for the first time, but whose name is alleged to be registered in several places. Akhilesh said the young man is educated and honest. He will cast his vote at only one place, but other people could vote in his name elsewhere. He sought a response from the Election Commission on the matter and targeted the BJP. He said the issue of 20 booth-level officers (BLOs) losing their lives during the SIR had also come to light. Akhilesh alleged that when evidence of irregularities in the voter list emerges, attempts are made to brush them aside by calling them minor errors. He also questioned the role of the Election Commission. 2- Workers were present at booths on 17 and 24 Akhilesh appealed to party workers to get voters' names added during the campaigns to be held at polling booths on 17 and 24 October. He said the process of adding and deleting names from the electoral roll should be transparent. 3-There should be no second revision after SSR The Samajwadi Party chief demanded that there should be no second revision after SSR. He alleged that the BJP starts responding whenever questions are raised with the Election Commission. He also questioned the role of companies such as TCS. 4-BJP voters are moving away from it Akhilesh Yadav said that voters from several sections who traditionally support the BJP were angry with the party. According to him, Sanatani voters were upset by allegations of theft involving donations and religious offerings. Women were also angry. He alleged that a mother had been insulted after the fire incident in Lucknow. He said the middle class was troubled by inflation and corruption. Young people were angry over alleged irregularities in examinations such as NEET. Akhilesh claimed that Gen-Z and Gen-Alpha, as well as beneficiaries of government schemes, were also moving away from the BJP. Taking a jibe at the BJP, he said the party spoke of "One Nation, One Election", but its intention was more like "One Corruption, One Election". 5- y for the panchayat elections Asked about the panchayat elections, Akhilesh Yadav said he was ready for every election. He alleged that the financial burden on village heads had increased and that the position of panchayat representatives had weakened. Alleging irregularities in the Kundarki and Meerapur by-elections, he said that after this, the Election Commission changed the rules related to providing CCTV footage. Akhilesh also claimed that no action had been taken on Nandlal Nishad's complaint. Former BJP MP Rajpal Saini joins the Samajwadi Party Akhilesh Yadav welcomed BJP leader and former MP Rajpal Saini, BJP state executive committee member Harbir Malik and other leaders who joined the party. He said that strengthening mutual love, compassion and a sense of belonging would make the PDA family stronger. A large number of people from the Kashyap, Dalit and other communities have joined the Samajwadi Party. This will increase the party's strength and public support. Akhilesh said, "This is only the beginning. Legislators have not yet been welcomed. There are many of them as well. There are also several parties that are bargaining. Once they have worked out their calculations, we will turn our attention to them as well." SP national general secretary Shivpal Singh Yadav said that the SP's caravan was moving ahead rapidly. Several influential people from the state are joining the party under Akhilesh Yadav's leadership. He claimed that in the 2027 Assembly election, the people of the state, including farmers, the poor and the youth, would work to form an SP government. -------------------- Read this news too... Minister Rajbhar says a dozen SP MLAs are in touch, all eager to join Panchayati Raj Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar took a swipe at SP chief Akhilesh Yadav, saying that the election is to be held in Uttar Pradesh, but Akhilesh is staging protests in Delhi. He said Akhilesh would have gained even 10 votes if he had visited a village in Uttar Pradesh, but instead he was going to Delhi and telling lies. Rajbhar claimed that around a dozen SP MLAs were in touch with him. Read the full story...

stories.title: Rajbhar says government is ready for panchayat polls:Awaiting OBC Commission report, clarity expected in a month
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Panchayati Raj Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar said the government was ready to hold the panchayat elections and was only waiting for the OBC Commission's report. The government would announce the election dates immediately after receiving it. According to Rajbhar, the state government set up the OBC Commission on the Supreme Court's orders. The commission is working to determine OBC reservation for the panchayat elections and will submit its report within a month. Speaking at a membership enrolment ceremony held at the SBSP headquarters, he said: "The Allahabad High Court has ordered the government to hold the panchayat elections within three months. The government welcomes this decision. We are ready to comply with the High Court's order. The election process will be taken forward as soon as the commission's report arrives. After that, there will be no need to approach the Supreme Court. Ballot papers have already reached the districts. We will not back out of the elections." 'In SP, P stands for dynastic politics and D stands for the wealthy' Rajbhar also targeted Akhilesh Yadav and the Samajwadi Party. He said it was the Samajwadi Party's leaders who had approached the High Court over the panchayat elections. During his tenure, Akhilesh Yadav promoted only certain castes. If his intentions had been honest, young people from the Nai, Rajbhar and Banjara communities would also have been given the opportunity to become police constables. Taking a jibe at the Samajwadi Party's PDA (backward classes, Dalits and minorities) slogan, Rajbhar said its truth was exposed in the Rajya Sabha elections. He alleged that the "P" in the Samajwadi Party stood for dynastic politics, which was why Ram Gopal Yadav was sent to the Rajya Sabha. The "D", meanwhile, stood for wealth. He questioned the decision to give Parimal Nathwani an opportunity. Instead of giving leaders from other castes a chance, the Samajwadi Party prioritised wealthy people. 76 leaders from the SP, LJP and VHP join the SBSP Leaders and workers from several parties joined the SBSP at the membership ceremony. All of them joined the party in the presence of Om Prakash Rajbhar.

stories.title: Five family members killed in Bulandshahr car crash:Vehicle hits tree at 100 kmph, three critically injured
stories.summary: Five people from the same family were killed and three others were seriously injured after a speeding Maruti Eeco van crashed into a roadside tree in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, on Friday. Eight people were travelling in the van when the accident took place. The family was on its way from Sidhpura in Kasganj district to the historic Belon temple in Dibai to offer prayers. The accident took place in the Narora police station area of Dibai tehsil, around 40 km from the district headquarters. The impact was so severe that the van was badly damaged, leaving the occupants trapped inside. Cries for help were heard at the spot. Eyewitnesses said the van appeared to be travelling at more than 100 kmph. The collision was so powerful that it sounded like an explosion. Two women, three men and three children were in the van A total of eight family members were travelling in the van. They included two women, three men, an 11-year-old girl, a five-year-old child and a one-year-old girl. Five people died in the accident. The deceased included a one-year-old girl, a woman aged around 35 and three men aged approximately 40 to 45 years. Police rescued the injured and sent them to hospital After receiving information about the accident, local police reached the spot and began rescue work. Police and local residents helped pull the injured and the deceased out of the damaged van. The three injured people were taken by ambulance to a nearby hospital for initial treatment. Due to their serious condition, doctors referred them to a higher medical centre. Five deaths leave family and village in mourning Administrative officials reached the spot to assess the situation. The bodies were taken into custody and sent for post-mortem examinations. The deaths of five members of the same family have left their native village, Sidhpura in Kasganj district, in mourning. Their relatives are devastated by the sudden loss. See the pictures- The story is being continuously updated...

stories.title: Third CCTV of accused model Shraddha Dubey surfaces:Seen on rickshaw with sister Rashmi and two men; keeps changing locations in Nepal
stories.summary: Another CCTV recording of model Shraddha Dubey, who fled to Nepal in connection with the murder of Lucknow businessman Shiva Sharma, has emerged. In the footage that surfaced on Thursday night, Shraddha is seen with her sister Rashmi, friend Adil and another young man. All four are seen travelling somewhere in two e-rickshaws. Earlier, police had obtained two CCTV recordings from Nepal's Mahim Nagar bus station. In the first recording, Shraddha, Rashmi and Adil are seen crossing the road, while the second shows them travelling in an e-rickshaw. However, it has not yet been established where the latest CCTV recording was made or who the fourth person seen in it is. Shraddha has been absconding since the millionaire businessman died after falling from the fourth floor of Awadh Green Apartment on 9 October. She has been evading the police along with her sister and friend. She has been continuously changing her location in Nepal. As a result, she remains out of the police's reach. Meanwhile, Shraddha released three videos and recounted the full story of the night of the incident. She said, "I did not run away. Shiva has committed suicide. I want to tell the truth." Two videos of Shiva, recorded before his death, have also emerged. In the videos, a woman is threatening Shiva. Watch three CCTV clips Read what the CCTV footage shows What did the accused model say in the video? Read on 2 videos of millionaire Shiva emerge after Shraddha's Two videos of Shiva Sharma, recorded before his death, also emerged on Thursday. In the videos, a woman is threatening Shiva. She is claimed to be Shraddha Dubey. However, the police have not confirmed this so far. Shraddha accuses him of stealing three gold chains and a bracelet. She asks Shiva to return around ₹6 lakh. Shiva assures her that he will return the money. He says, "I am giving it in writing that I will return the money. Keep my car and give me the money." Dainik Bhaskar had already reported: Shraddha fled to Nepal Dainik Bhaskar had reported on 12 October that Shraddha had fled to Nepal with her old friend Aamir. Aamir had taken her to the Nepal border. He had left the KGMU Trauma Centre with Shraddha, her sister Rashmi and companion Adil in a Swift car. At some point on the way, Shraddha left Aamir's car and switched to her own Scorpio. Aamir dropped the three of them at Rupaidiha in Bahraich. On 13 October, the police announced a reward of ₹25,000 each for Shraddha Dubey, her sister Rashmi Dubey and the driver Tanveer Ali alias Danish. stories.title: Extortion in Home Guard recruitment, 3 detained including 2 doctors:Accused allegedly declared candidates unfit over crooked noses and weak eyesight
stories.summary: There was a major uproar in Kanpur over alleged extortion during the medical tests for Home Guard recruitment. Candidates alleged that they were asked for money after being threatened with being declared unfit in the medical examination. They beat up a youth named Ajit, who was sitting in a doctor's car at the police lines, and handed him over to the police. A police investigation confirmed that money had been transferred online. Following this, Kotwali police registered a case on the basis of a complaint filed by an official from the Home Guard Commandant's office. Three people, including two doctors on the panel, have been detained and are being questioned. Meanwhile, two youths are said to have fled after the uproar. The Home Guard examination was held in April, while the results were released on 29 June. Medical tests are now being conducted for the selected candidates after document verification and the physical test. The medical tests will be held from 15 October to 29 October. Read full story The medical tests of selected Home Guard candidates are being conducted at the Kanpur Police Lines from 15 to 29 October. On the first day, 15 October, 200 candidates had been called. The Chief Medical Officer had constituted a three-member panel of doctors for the medical examination. It comprised Dr Praveen, Dr Mahesh Dwivedi and Dr Devendra Singh Rajput. At around 8 p.m. on Thursday, the candidates began creating a ruckus, accusing the doctors of malpractice. They alleged that the doctors were threatening to declare them medically unfit by claiming that they had a deviated nasal bone or eye problems. They were allegedly demanding money in return. According to the candidates, ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 was demanded from them by claiming that their noses were deviated, while ₹50,000 was demanded by citing eye problems. It is alleged that the candidates were given a slip bearing a mobile number and told to contact the number and pay the money. Some candidates alleged that money had been paid online and in cash to Ajit, the driver who was in the doctor's car. It is being reported that Ajit stays with Dr Mahesh Dwivedi. Online transactions found during investigation; three, including two doctors, detained ACP Kotwali Amit Pandey and ACP Colonelganj Anjana Dahiya arrived at the spot after receiving information about the commotion. During the investigation, police found that money had been transferred to an online account. Dr Praveen Kumar, Dr Mahesh Dwivedi and their driver, Ajit, were then detained and questioned. On the basis of a complaint from an official of the Home Guard Commandant's Office, Kotwali police registered a case and began an investigation. Candidate allegedly slapped over accusation of stealing a bag from a car Media personnel who arrived after being informed of the disturbance were initially stopped from entering the police lines. Later, some media personnel managed to get inside and began speaking to the candidates. During this, the candidates showed them a car. They alleged that a paper kept inside the car contained the names of candidates who had paid money. After being informed, ACP Kotwali Amit Pandey and Kotwali Station House Officer Arun Kumar Dwivedi reached the car with police personnel. During this, the police accused the candidates of stealing a bag from the car. It is alleged that Kotwali SHO Arun Kumar Dwivedi then slapped one of the candidates and took him inside for questioning. Recruitment examination held for 41,424 posts The written examination for 41,424 Uttar Pradesh Home Guard posts was held on 25, 26 and 27 April. More than 19 lakh candidates took part in it. The result was released on 29 June, with 1,07,221 candidates passing. Following document verification and the physical examination, the selected candidates are now undergoing medical tests. Examination cancelled, new date to be announced later Home Guard Commandant Preeti Sharma said- "The recruitment examination scheduled for 15 October has been cancelled. A new date will be fixed for the cancelled examination. Candidates will be informed accordingly." What the candidates said The candidate alleged that applicants were being deliberately declared unfit during the medical test because money was being demanded. Every candidate was being declared unfit after being marked down for DNS (a deviated nasal bone). He said some candidates had already cleared the medical examination for central government jobs, but were being declared unfit here on the basis of DNS. According to the candidate, the DNS test was being conducted even though it was not mandatory. After declaring candidates unfit in the test, ₹50,000 was allegedly being demanded from some, ₹20,000 from others and ₹40,000 from others. He claimed that money had been taken from at least 25 to 30 candidates. Some people had also made online transactions. He demanded that the police investigate the bank accounts of the candidates concerned and their Google Pay transactions. Candidate says-They are declaring candidates unfit and demanding money Candidate Vinay Kumar said, I am also an examinee and have been selected for the Home Guard recruitment. The commotion was over allegations of irregularities at the Reserve Police Lines. Here, doctors are marking every other candidate with a point in DNS and declaring them unfit. They are saying that the candidates' nasal bones are crooked. On the first day, 200 candidates were called, of whom 70 to 80 are being told that they have crooked noses. After this, they were demanding ₹50,000. They would not settle for less. If the nose was crooked, candidates were being asked to pay ₹15,000 to ₹20,000. Medical examinations were initially conducted properly, then doctors began failing candidates One candidate said that the medical examinations of 10-12 candidates were conducted properly at first. After that, the doctors began declaring them unfit. They then started writing down a number and telling candidates to contact it. When contacted, a person would arrive and demand money. They were demanding up to ₹50,000 from each candidate.

stories.title: 27-year-old woman strangled to death in Saharanpur:Body found on bed in room; brother discovered it when he went to wake her up
stories.summary: A 27-year-old Village Development Officer (VDO) was strangled to death in Saharanpur on Thursday night. At the time of the incident, her parents had gone to sleep in the courtyard in front of their house. When they reached home on Friday morning, they found their daughter's body lying on the bed. The family began screaming after seeing her body. Neighbours arrived on hearing the noise. The police were then informed. As soon as they received the information, the police reached the spot with a forensic team. They spoke to the family and gathered details about the incident. After collecting evidence from the scene, they sent the body for a post-mortem examination. The incident took place in the Nangal police station area, about 25 kilometres from the headquarters. Read the full case in detail She went to sleep in her room after dinner People said Komal was a resident of Lakhanour village. She was a village service officer employed on a contractual basis. She lived with her father Virendra, mother and two younger brothers. On Thursday night, Komal went to sleep in her room after dinner. Her parents then went to sleep in the enclosure in front of the house. Parents found dead body on the bed At around 8 a.m., when her parents returned home, they went to their daughter's room. Komal's eyes were closed. They called out to her, but she did not wake up. They then tried to wake her by shaking her, but there was no movement in her body. Komal's mother then began screaming. Neighbours arrived after hearing the cries. They immediately informed the police. Samples collected and sent for examination Shortly after receiving the information, the police arrived with a forensic team. They gathered information about the incident from the family. The family said they had dinner with Komal at night. After that, Komal went to her room. We went to sleep in the enclosure built in front of the house. When we went to wake our daughter in the morning, we found her body. She was strangled to death. The forensic team collected samples from the room. After the samples were collected, the body was sent by ambulance for a post-mortem examination. Police said - murder investigation underway SP Rural Mayank Pathak said that the police received information in the morning that the body of a young woman had been found at a house. The police then reached the spot and took information about the incident from her family members. Samples were collected from the spot and sent for examination. It has not yet been established who committed the murder or why; efforts are underway to find out.

Speaking at a press conference in Lucknow, Rajnath said: Rahul Gandhi and his allies must understand that democracy is not a licence to undermine constitutional institutions or obstruct the country's development journey. The country cannot be sacrificed for political self-interest. Rahul should respect the people's mandate and reflect on his role. We must choose the path of nation-building, not confrontation. He said that three major and unforgettable crimes had been committed during Congress rule: first, imposing the Emergency on the country in 1975; second, the massacre of Sikhs in 1985; and third, supporting the person who ordered the firing on kar sevaks in 1990. Key points from Rajnath's press conference- 1. Opposition's sole agenda is to set the country on fire Rajnath said, "An attempt is being made to use the country's youth as pawns in the politics of anarchy. They speak openly about bringing down the government. This makes it clear that their sole agenda is to destroy democratic institutions and set the country on fire." 2. A conspiracy is being hatched to seize power The Defence Minister said that the use of terms such as 'Regime Change' made it clear that their fight was not for electoral reforms. Their fight was neither for SIR and Gyanesh Kumar nor for the bright future of the country's youth. Rather, it was part of their conspiracy to create chaos in the country and seize power by any means.

stories.title: HC says UP Police appears to consider itself above law:Man detained before FIR; discrepancies in documents, release him immediately
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court has reprimanded the Uttar Pradesh Police. The court said, The police consider themselves above the law. They believe that acting arbitrarily is their right. They think no one will question their mistakes. Even if questions are raised, they will make excuses and escape accountability. The court was hearing a petition concerning the detention of Deepak, a resident of Noida, before an FIR was registered. A division bench comprising Justices Atul Sridharan and Achal Sachdeva allowed Deepak's habeas corpus petition and declared his detention completely unlawful. The court ordered that Deepak be released immediately if he was not wanted in any other case. It also directed that a 'bad remark' for negligence be recorded in the service files of ACP Kamlesh Kant and investigating officer Anuj Kumar. Entire matter step by step The matter dates back to 23 August 2026. According to police records, a dispute arose between two parties over a property. At 7:34 p.m. that day, Deepak and four other people were taken into custody, while the FIR was registered at 9:39 p.m. Deepak's arrest was shown as having taken place at 2:57 p.m. on 24 August 2026. The documents related to the arrest and search recorded 23 August as the date at five places, while the arrest was shown as having taken place on 24 August. What the court said The High Court found that the police had taken Deepak into custody even before the FIR was registered. He was formally arrested later while in custody. The court said the reason for the arrest must be clearly recorded, and documents should not be prepared merely as a formality. The court found that the investigating officer had signed a document dated 23 August, while the date of arrest was recorded as 24 August. The documents related to the search and seizure were dated 23 August. The court said discrepancies were found in the dates at five places, but they were neither corrected nor was the amendment authenticated. Investigating Officer Anuj Kumar described this as a mistake in writing the dates, but that explanation is not convincing. Amount column blank in bond; no signature, date or time either The court also found deficiencies in the documents relating to the security proceedings. The amount column in the bond was blank. The required signature, date and time had also not been recorded, making it impossible to determine whether the ACP had approved the bond. The notice dated 24 August bore the signature of ACP-II Kamlesh Kant, even though it had been issued in the name of ACP-I. On this basis, the High Court expressed suspicion that the documents may have been filled in later. Deepak may have been made to sign a blank sheet of paper. The investigating officer may then have signed it, while space was left blank at the top for the reason for the arrest to be written. Tense situation no excuse for breaking the law The state government argued that the situation was tense at the time of the incident and that a crowd had gathered at the scene. The police took action to prevent the situation from deteriorating. The High Court made it clear that tense circumstances do not exempt the police from their responsibility to follow the law. It is the police's duty to follow the procedure for arrest and detention. The court said that Article 22(1) of the Constitution gives citizens the right to know the reasons for their arrest and to seek legal protection. The police cannot disregard the law. The High Court also expressed displeasure over the magistrate's role, saying the magistrate had not examined whether the law had been followed during the proceedings. This is a serious lapse. Should officers be taught what the correct legal procedure is? The court expressed displeasure over the manner in which ACP Kamlesh Kant and investigating officer Anuj Kumar had carried out their duties. It said that neither officer had any knowledge of the provisions of the new criminal law (BNSS) or the correct procedure. The court directed the DGP to create a system for training police officers. Officers should be taught the correct legal procedures, the rules for making an arrest and how to safeguard the rights of the general public. Court says such action will not be tolerated The court also expressed concern over cases in which suspects are allegedly kept at police stations for more than 24 hours and released later. The bench warned that such action would not be tolerated in future on the pretext of not knowing the legal procedure.

stories.title: Family mourns Labrador’s death in Gorakhpur:Dog died on October 3; family printed feast invitations and held a 13th-day ceremony
stories.summary: A family in Gorakhpur held a prayer meeting and a traditional feast in memory of their pet Labrador, Buffy, who died on October 3. The family, deeply attached to the dog, arranged a ceremony similar to those held after a person’s death, including printing invitation cards for relatives and friends. The family also organised a Sunderkand recital at home on the 13th day after Buffy’s death, seeking peace for his soul. Buffy lived with the family for seven years Anil Mishra, a resident of Azad Nagar in Rustampur, was Buffy’s owner. He said the dog was loved not only by him but also by other family members and relatives, who had developed a strong emotional bond with him. The family brought Buffy home when he was just 10 days old. He lived with them for seven years before developing a liver-related illness. Mishra said the family sought treatment from experienced doctors, but Buffy died on October 3 while battling the illness. Invitation cards printed in Buffy’s memory The invitation card issued by the family carried the words “Humble Tribute” at the top, followed by an invitation to a Brahmbhoj feast in memory of the late Buffy. His photograph was placed prominently against a golden decorative background. The card was printed in both Hindi and English. It invited guests to attend the feast at 4 pm on October 15 at the family’s home, House No. 454B, in Azad Nagar. Family and friends attend Sunderkand recital The family also organised a Sunderkand recital at home on October 15 for the peace of Buffy’s soul. Relatives and friends joined the family for the ceremony. Mishra said the event was a way for the family to express its affection for Buffy and remember the bond they shared with him.

stories.title: Rajnath Singh’s Lucknow visit day 2:Defence Minister to attend Durga Puja; will meet social groups and visit bereaved families
stories.summary: Union Defence Minister and Lucknow MP Rajnath Singh is on the second day of his three-day visit to Lucknow on Friday. He will meet representatives of various social organisations at his residence on Kalidas Marg before visiting bereaved families in different parts of the city to offer his condolences. In the evening, Singh will attend a Durga Puja programme at Ram-Ram Bank Chauraha in Sector E of Jankipuram. To meet representatives of social organisations BJP Lucknow Mahanagar president Anand Dwivedi said Singh would meet representatives of social organisations at his residence on Friday. He will then visit the homes of families who have recently lost a member and offer his condolences to the bereaved relatives. To attend Durga Puja programme at 6 pm Singh is scheduled to attend the Durga Puja programme at Ram-Ram Bank Chauraha in Sector E, Jankipuram, at 6 pm. After the event, he will return to his residence on Kalidas Marg for the night. To leave for Delhi on Saturday According to the scheduled programme, Singh will leave for Delhi on Saturday, October 17. He is due to depart from his Kalidas Marg residence for Lucknow airport at 11.30 am. His departure will mark the conclusion of his three-day visit to Lucknow.

stories.title: Gorakhpur POCSO case:No witness appears in court, stalling trial in 10-year-old girl’s rape-murder case; next hearing on October 16
stories.summary: The hearing in the case involving the alleged rape and murder of a 10-year-old girl who went missing from Gorakhpur District Hospital could not proceed on Thursday after no witness appeared before the POCSO court. The court has scheduled the next hearing for October 16. The cross-examination of the sixth witness had been completed earlier, and his statement was recorded in court. During Wednesday’s hearing, Ashhar Jameel, who runs a plywood shop opposite V-Mart on Bank Road, testified in the case. He authenticated CCTV footage recorded by cameras installed at his shop. The investigating officer had collected the footage during the investigation and preserved it on a pen drive as evidence. The defence began cross-examining Jameel, but the process was completed on October 14. Six witnesses have testified so far Six witnesses, including the victim’s father and elder sister, have testified in the case so far. They also include an expert who analysed the CCTV footage, a police officer responsible for maintaining case records at Kotwali police station, and the school principal. The trial is being conducted in a special court under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. What happened in the case? On the night of July 28, the 10-year-old girl went to Gorakhpur District Hospital to deliver food to her elder sister, who was admitted there. She went missing during the visit. When the family began searching for her, they learnt that a man wearing a police uniform had taken her away. Police subsequently used CCTV footage and surveillance to investigate the case. The investigation allegedly identified Abhishek Yadav, a police constable posted with Dial 112 and a resident of Ghazipur, as the accused in the kidnapping. Girl’s body found near Rohin river According to police, the accused confessed during questioning in custody to raping and murdering the girl. Her body was recovered on July 30 from the banks of the Rohin river in Chiutaha. Following the case, the accused constable was dismissed from service and sent to jail. stories.title: Varanasi firecracker blast:Neighbours heard 3 loud explosions; Raju ran illegal firecrackers unit behind clothing business
stories.summary: A powerful explosion at a house in Varanasi’s Paigambarpur area on Thursday evening partially brought down the building and damaged neighbouring homes. Residents said they heard three loud explosions and described the impact as similar to an earthquake. The house belonged to Raju Khan, who allegedly manufactured and stored firecrackers illegally on the premises. Neighbours claimed he ran a clothing business to avoid drawing attention to the firecracker-making operation. Four people were injured in the incident, including Raju’s wife, Chandni, their son Adil, 16, and daughter Arabia, 10. A woman living in a neighbouring house was also injured. Police, State Disaster Response Force (SDRF) and National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) teams reached the spot after receiving information about the blast. Before their arrival, neighbours had rescued three members of Raju’s family from the damaged house and taken them to hospital. Raju and his 65-year-old mother, Munni, were not found at the scene when police arrived. They had allegedly left before the police reached the spot. In these circumstances, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to people whose houses were damaged in the blast. Read the report… First, take a look at three pictures of the incident ‘Three loud explosions shook the neighbourhood’ Pari Kesari, whose father Ajay Kumar Kesari lives directly opposite Raju’s house, recalled being outside with her younger sister when the incident occurred. “We were walking in the lane with my little sister in my arms. Suddenly, at around 5 pm, we heard a sound like a small firecracker. Before we could understand what had happened, a woman from the neighbourhood pulled us inside. Then there were three loud explosions, and the entire building came crashing down,” she said. Pari said dust filled the lane and her mother was injured while rushing towards them. The blast also shattered the windows of their house and caused cracks in its walls. She added that several people in the neighbourhood had suffered injuries. Residents said the explosion caused widespread panic, with some initially suspecting that an inverter or a gas cylinder had exploded. ‘I thought my inverter had exploded’ Priyank Prajapati, who lives directly opposite Raju’s house, said he was conducting a mock test at home when he heard the first explosion. “There was suddenly a loud sound, followed by a huge amount of smoke. I turned around and thought my inverter had exploded. But when I checked, its green light was still on, which meant it was working,” he said. He then checked his kitchen and gas cylinder, but both appeared to be intact. When he looked towards Raju’s house, he saw that the building had been badly damaged and smoke and dust had spread everywhere. Priyank said the walls of his kitchen had cracked, while some sections had collapsed. He added that a neighbouring woman had also been injured and that the glass in her windows had shattered. Neighbours claim firecracker-making continued behind clothing business Priyank alleged that Raju had been jailed during the COVID-19 pandemic in connection with firecracker manufacturing. According to him, Raju later resumed a clothing business, but it was allegedly only a front for continuing to manufacture firecrackers. Priyank claimed that firecrackers were made at the house regularly and that other family members were also involved. These claims have not been independently verified. Local resident Dilip said the family was widely known in the neighbourhood for making firecrackers. He claimed that Munni’s husband and son-in-law had died in firecracker-related explosions years ago. Another resident, Chandrakala, said firecrackers were manufactured at the property, which was divided between Raju and his brother. She said the blast felt as though the ground had shaken and caused considerable damage to nearby homes. Woman says blast left her ears numb Local resident Soni Kesari said she was standing in a veranda near a room used for worship when the explosion occurred. “The blast was so sudden that my ears went numb. I started screaming and ran away without looking back. There was panic throughout the house and the neighbourhood,” she said, adding that she had sustained injuries and her home had been badly damaged. Asha Prajapati, whose house shares a wall with Raju’s property, said she was outside in the lane when the explosion occurred. She said the blast covered people in dust and left her with an eye injury. She compared the experience to an earthquake. Asha also alleged that Munni had previously argued with residents over their complaints to the police about the firecracker-making operation. Three family members rescued; woman critically injured According to the account of the incident, the blast occurred at around 5 pm on Thursday in the densely populated Paigambarpur area under the Sarnath police station area. The explosion brought down the front half of Raju’s two-storey, 450-square-foot house. The family members were reportedly in the rear section at the time. Neighbours pulled Chandni, 39, Adil, 16, and Arabia, 10, out of the damaged building and took them to hospital. Chief Medical Officer Dr Narendra Pratap Singh said the injured were admitted to Kabirchaura Divisional Hospital. Chandni had suffered burns over around 90% of her body and was admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU). Adil had also sustained injuries, including bleeding from his nose, and was admitted to the ICU. Arabia’s condition was stable. Police and disaster response teams reached the scene to assist with the response. Neighbours claimed they had previously complained to the police about the alleged illegal firecracker factory.

stories.summary: A man accused of murdering his girlfriend, who died after falling from the 10th floor of a hotel in Lucknow, surrendered before an ACJM court on Thursday. Avneesh Jaiswal had been absconding since the incident. Police are preparing toat the 24-year-old woman, identified as Samreen, died due to shock and haemorrhage caused by s question the accused as part of their investigation. Meanwhile, the post-mortem report stated there were injuries. She suffered fractures to her waist and both legs, along with serious head injuries. ACP (Gosainganj) Rishabh Yadav said Avneesh Jaiswal, son of Santlal Jaiswal and a resident of Firozpur Khurd in Dostpur, Sultanpur district, surrendered before the court on Thursday. Police will question him as the investigation progresses. Woman fell from hotel’s 10th floor on Monday According to police, Samreen died after falling from Room 1037 on the 10th floor of Hotel Celestial Manor, located in Omaxe New Hazratganj in Lucknow’s Sushant Golf City area, at around 6.30 pm on Monday. Samreen was the daughter of Mohammad Tajju, a resident of Hata Surat Singh in the Chowk police station area. She had arrived at the hotel with Avneesh at 11.46 am on Monday. Mother alleged boyfriend pushed her Samreen’s mother, Sufia Bano, had alleged that Avneesh lured her daughter to the hotel and tried to force himself on her. She claimed that when Samreen resisted, he pushed her from the 10th floor. These allegations have not yet been established and will be subject to the police investigation. Police registered a murder case against Avneesh based on a complaint filed by Samreen’s sister, Seeba. He had been absconding since the incident. Following directions from the Deputy Commissioner of Police (South), two police teams and a surveillance team had been deployed to trace and arrest him.

stories.title: Mother says teacher misbehaved with daughter:Used to make obscene remarks; 50-year-old government teacher tried to rape her in Mirzapur
stories.summary: My daughter studies in Class 7 at a government school. The teacher did something very wrong to her. He called her into the classroom on the pretext of turning on the television and then began touching her inappropriately. When she ran away in fear, he covered her mouth. He touched her private parts and threatened and intimidated her. I want my daughter to get justice and the teacher to receive strict punishment. This is what the mother from Mirzapur says. Her 14-year-old daughter was allegedly raped by a 50-year-old teacher. The girl is also a good volleyball player. The incident took place in the school classroom on 8 October. On the mother's complaint, the police registered a case under the POCSO Act and several other sections on 13 October. The teacher has not been coming to school since the incident, having applied for medical leave. The girl is so frightened that she starts crying whenever she tries to tell anyone anything. She has not attended school for five days. The Dainik Bhaskar team travelled 20 km from the district headquarters and spoke to the girl and her mother. Read the report... Girl travels 1 km from home to attend school The girl lives in a village under the jurisdiction of Kachhwa police station. She lives with her parents and younger brother. Her elder sister is studying while staying at a relative's house. Her father supports the family through farming. There is a higher primary school 1 km from their home. The girl studies in Class 7 there. The school has 175 children, including 90 boys and 85 girls. In addition to female principal, Nirmala Singh, two government teachers and three Shikshamitras are appointed here. Manoj Kumar Gautam has been posted here as an assistant teacher since 2017. Before this, he was posted in Chunar. An instructor had also complained against him in Chunar, following which he was transferred here. Read what the victim girl said The girl said, ‘I used to play volleyball until Class 6. I stopped playing in Class 7. After that, the teacher would say vulgar things to the other girls and to us. For the past two to three months, he had been making obscene remarks to me and touching me here and there.’ There was a cooking competition at our school on 8 October. All the girls prepared food. I also made manchurian. All the girls went to give the food to the teacher, but we did not go. The teacher asked the girls to call us to the classroom. He asked, 'Do you know how to operate a TV?' I said no. He said he would teach me and began touching me inappropriately from behind. When I shouted and tried to run away, he covered my mouth. After that, he did something wrong to me. Mother says daughter had been withdrawn for several months The girl's mother said her daughter had been withdrawn for quite some time. She began crying after returning from school on the day of the incident. I calmed her down and tried to reassure her, after which she told me that Manoj sir had done something wrong to her. He had another girl call my daughter. On the pretext of turning on the television, he touched her private parts. When my daughter tried to scream, he covered her mouth with his hand. The girl somehow managed to break free and ran away from there. After returning to class, she began crying. The teacher also started threatening her there, saying that if she told anyone at home, they would expel her from the school. He also threatened to have her mother and father sent to jail. Fled school, issued threats over the phone The mother said, My daughter came home crying. She could not even explain what had happened. We tried to comfort her, and she then told us everything in fear. We immediately went to the school, but Manoj had already left. When I called him, he said, 'We will impose the SC/ST Act on all of you. Instead, we will have you sent to jail. The next day, we went to the police. The police also kept sending us from one place to another. The case was registered, but no action has been taken so far. We only want the administration to take the strictest possible action. The guilty person should be punished. My daughter must get justice. Accused made children play instead of the games teacher Some people, speaking on condition of anonymity, said that a games teacher is posted at the school. The school's children had been selected for a state-level volleyball competition. However, Manoj made the children play himself instead of the games teacher. He brainwashed the children. Last year, the school's children were supposed to travel to Ayodhya to play in a competition. A woman teacher and the games teacher were supposed to accompany them. However, he incited the children to such an extent that they began saying, "We will not go without Manoj sir." The victim had also gone to play, but she was not included in the team there. Principal says: After being made aware, girl told her mother Principal Nirmala Singh said what happened was completely wrong. Just two or three days ago, we explained "good touch and bad touch" to all the girls at the school. We made them aware that they should not tolerate such things. After being made aware, the girl told her mother about it. If necessary, I will personally accompany the girl to file a complaint. Police station in-charge Amar Jeet Chauhan said, "A case has been registered on the mother's complaint. The girl's statement has been recorded. She will undergo a medical examination at the district hospital. Further action will be taken based on the medical report and the allegations."

This historic land, held by the Pollard family since 1940 and boasting valuable lakefront access, is set to transition to the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department by late 2027. The park will offer recreational opportunities while preserving the area’s ecological integrity, enabling the public to connect with nature.

stories.title: Subway co-founder’s relative buys Connecticut warehouse for $6.75 million, plans renovation
stories.summary: A member of the Buck family has purchased a Danbury warehouse previously owned by the Salame family. This transaction, completed for $6.75 million, signals a commitment to modernizing the site while preserving its industrial purpose. Plans include extensive renovations and the construction of an office building alongside the warehouse. The investment reflects confidence in the local economy and aims to maintain vibrant commercial use of the property.

stories.title: Why are uninsured vehicles not part of crash relief scheme? Supreme Court
stories.summary: Taking note that “Compensation to Victims (Interim Relief) Scheme, 2026” has not been notified or publicised, a bench of Justices JB Pardiwala and KV Viswanathan directed the govt to publicise it to ensure awareness. People must be made aware of their right to seek interim compensation, it said. Union road transport ministry officials said the scheme will be notified as provided for under Central Motor Vehicle Act.

stories.title: Rosatom completes supply of engineered safety features actuation systems for Kudankulam N-plant units 3 and 4
stories.summary: In total, about 300 items of equipment were manufactured and delivered to the plant – four sets of ESFAS CS in accordance with the number of safety instrumentation and control trains, per each power unit featuring VVER-1000 reactors. ESFAS is the system that monitors the process parameters of a power unit when there is a deviation from normal operation conditions.

stories.title: New norms for DL: Driving tutorial pass mark may rise to 75%, select licence services to be free
stories.summary: Under the proposal, the safe-driving tutorial would have to last at least 30 minutes. The higher qualifying score of 70% is aimed at making the assessment more stringent. The draft also proposes a defined procedure for online applications to change driving licence particulars, including name and address. Licencing authorities would have to approve or reject applications for changes within 15 days, giving reasons for rejection.

stories.title: Cincinnati’s vacant Terrace Plaza Hotel faces fresh redevelopment hurdles over tax dispute
stories.summary: Cincinnati's iconic Terrace Plaza Hotel has stood vacant since 2008, currently tied up in redevelopment plans. A contentious property tax valuation dispute between the owner and the city's school district has caused delays. This $160 million project seeks to honor the hotel's historical significance while also requiring a resolution of tax issues to proceed with construction, maintaining its vital role in the city’s architectural legacy.

stories.title: Sienna Miller’s £1.75m thatched cottage gets a £200k price cut
